_comment: Curated external datasets. Raw data is NOT committed (see .gitignore); run scripts/fetch_datasets.py. 'licence_listed' is what Kaggle shows; 'licence_verified' is what we found inside the files. 'commercial_ok' must be confirmed by counsel before any production use.

datasets.size: 816 clauses, 10 sources (Zomato, Nykaa, Swiggy, BigBasket, PhonePe, Flipkart, Razorpay, UIDAI, Ola, 55 synthetic)
datasets.licence_verified: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Kaggle metadata only; no licence file in archive)
datasets.commercial_ok: yes, with attribution; ShareAlike applies to derived datasets we redistribute
datasets.quality_notes: Only public DPDPA-labelled dataset found. Noisy: 59% tagged S.5; notes read as LLM-written; some section errors (e.g. consent withdrawal tagged S.11 instead of S.6(4)); 21 rows with mojibake; risk_label is user-risk, not a compliance verdict. Use as seed/pre-labels, re-annotate for gold.

datasets.labels: binary + pattern category (Urgency, Scarcity, Social Proof, ...)

datasets.task: D: investigator scenario seeds; gdpr_text.csv is a corpus-structure template

datasets.quality_notes: Synthetic, Western names; no Indian identifiers.

datasets.task: B: PII token classification (54 classes, multilingual)
datasets.licence_verified: Ai4Privacy custom licence: free only for individuals/small businesses (<=3 staff); corporate licence required otherwise (licensing@ai4privacy.com). The Kaggle 'MIT' label is wrong.

datasets.quality_notes: Claims '100% valid Aadhaar' but only 1,011/10,000 pass Verhoeff (chance level); names/cities are US (e.g. 'Austintown, Wyoming'). Useful to test that our detector REJECTS invalid Aadhaar.

datasets.task: D: synthetic breach incidents for Sec 8(6)/Rule 7 workflows
datasets.size: 352 breaches (entity, year, records, org type, method)

datasets.task: D: Indian incident distributions for scenario generation
datasets.size: 1,200 rows (year, loss INR, type, city, category)
datasets.quality_notes: Appears synthetic/aggregated; use for distributions only.
441k rows of 2018 Android app policy URLs, not policy text. Skip.
Templated SC case-metadata questions ('Who is the respondent in X?'). No DPDPA value. Skip.

not_on_kaggle_recommended.name: OPP-115
not_on_kaggle_recommended.note: Best privacy-policy annotation corpus; check non-commercial terms.
